attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Louisiana corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Louisiana Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.la_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts, no transaction count as of 2023); result.la_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.la_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.la_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.la_tax_liability xdef "Louisiana filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Louisiana state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. LA 2025 tax reform introduced $20,000 standard deduction and eliminated federal income tax deduction.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Louisiana Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.la_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.la_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Louisiana state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.la_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.la_state_subtractions xdef "Louisiana adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Louisiana corporate income tax. Applies Louisiana flat rate (5.5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. 2025 tax reform replaced graduated rates up to 7.5% with flat 5.5% rate and introduced $20,000 standard deduction.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Louisiana Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.la_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.la_tax_liability xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.la_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Louisiana corporate tax (flat rate 5.5% - NEW for 2025); Apply Louisiana 5.5% flat rate
No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: // No taxable income - no tax liability 0.0 result.la_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.la_tax_liability xdef result.la_estimated_payments result.la_refund_or_owed xdef "Louisiana tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto

// No nexus - no tax liability 0.0 result.la_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.la_tax_liability xdef result.la_estimated_payments result.la_refund_or_owed xdef "Louisiana tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
